+"""Immutable, broker-neutral signal, provenance, and decision contracts.
+
+Only standard-library modules are imported at runtime.  Signals deliberately
+contain no quantity, order, fill, broker, or position-cycle state.
+
+Design choice (3 of 3 for these strategy/signal contracts):
+3. Signal IDs use the full 64-character SHA-256 hex digest of a compact JSON
+   array containing trimmed instance ID, normalized symbol, action value, and
+   the bar instant normalized to a microsecond-precision UTC ``Z`` timestamp.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from enum import Enum
+from types import MappingProxyType
+
+__all__ = [
+    "SignalAction",
+    "ENABLED_SIGNAL_ACTIONS",
+    "SignalProvenance",
+    "make_signal_id",
+    "Signal",
+    "DecisionOutcome",
+    "SignalDecision",
+]
+
+_STRATEGY_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$")
+
+
+def _require_non_empty_str(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _require_strategy_key(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field)
+    if _STRATEGY_KEY_RE.fullmatch(result) is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be lowercase snake_case; got {value!r}")
+    return result
+
+
+def _require_symbol(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field).upper()
+    if any(character.isspace() for character in result):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must not contain whitespace; got {value!r}")
+    return result
+
+
+def _require_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _to_decimal(value: object, *, field: str) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        result = value
+    elif isinstance(value, int):
+        result = Decimal(value)
+    elif isinstance(value, str):
+        text = value.strip()
+        if not text:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty numeric string")
+        try:
+            result = Decimal(text)
+        except InvalidOperation:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid decimal string: {value!r}") from None
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    if not result.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite; got {result!s}")
+    return result
+
+
+class SignalAction(Enum):
+    """Signal actions; short-side members are reserved but dormant."""
+
+    ENTER_LONG = "ENTER_LONG"
+    EXIT_LONG = "EXIT_LONG"
+    ENTER_SHORT = "ENTER_SHORT"
+    COVER_SHORT = "COVER_SHORT"
+
+
+ENABLED_SIGNAL_ACTIONS = frozenset({SignalAction.ENTER_LONG, SignalAction.EXIT_LONG})
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SignalProvenance:
+    """The market-data and optional research evidence behind a signal."""
+
+    data_provider: str
+    data_feed: str
+    is_consolidated: bool
+    timeframe: str
+    bar_time: datetime
+    indicator_snapshot: Mapping[str, Decimal | None]
+    research_source: str | None = None
+    research_as_of: datetime | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "data_provider",
+            _require_non_empty_str(self.data_provider, field="data_provider"),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "data_feed", _require_non_empty_str(self.data_feed, field="data_feed")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.is_consolidated, bool):
+            raise ValueError("is_consolidated must be bool")
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "timeframe", _require_non_empty_str(self.timeframe, field="timeframe")
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time"))
+        if not isinstance(self.indicator_snapshot, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError("indicator_snapshot must be a mapping")
+        snapshot: dict[str, Decimal | None] = {}
+        for key, value in self.indicator_snapshot.items():
+            if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
+                raise ValueError("indicator_snapshot keys must be non-empty strings")
+            snapshot[key] = None if value is None else _to_decimal(value, field=f"indicator[{key}]")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "indicator_snapshot", MappingProxyType(snapshot))
+        if self.research_source is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                "research_source",
+                _require_non_empty_str(self.research_source, field="research_source"),
+            )
+        if self.research_as_of is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                "research_as_of",
+                _require_utc(self.research_as_of, field="research_as_of"),
+            )
+
+
+def make_signal_id(
+    instance_id: str,
+    symbol: str,
+    action: SignalAction,
+    bar_time: datetime,
+) -> str:
+    """Return a stable SHA-256 identifier for one instance/action/bar."""
+    normalized_instance = _require_non_empty_str(instance_id, field="instance_id")
+    normalized_symbol = _require_symbol(symbol, field="symbol")
+    if not isinstance(action, SignalAction):
+        raise ValueError(f"action must be SignalAction; got {type(action).__name__}")
+    normalized_bar_time = _require_utc(bar_time, field="bar_time")
+    timestamp = normalized_bar_time.isoformat(timespec="microseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
+    canonical = json.dumps(
+        [normalized_instance, normalized_symbol, action.value, timestamp],
+        ensure_ascii=True,
+        separators=(",", ":"),
+    )
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class Signal:
+    """A strategy's immutable long-only actionable result."""
+
+    signal_id: str
+    strategy_key: str
+    strategy_version: str
+    instance_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    action: SignalAction
+    bar_time: datetime
+    generated_at: datetime
+    reference_price: Decimal | None
+    reason: str
+    provenance: SignalProvenance
+    confidence: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        strategy_key = _require_strategy_key(self.strategy_key, field="strategy_key")
+        strategy_version = _require_non_empty_str(
+            self.strategy_version, field="strategy_version"
+        )
+        instance_id = _require_non_empty_str(self.instance_id, field="instance_id")
+        symbol = _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol")
+        if not isinstance(self.action, SignalAction):
+            raise ValueError(f"action must be SignalAction; got {type(self.action).__name__}")
+        if self.action not in ENABLED_SIGNAL_ACTIONS:
+            raise ValueError(f"signal action {self.action.value} is not enabled")
+        bar_time = _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time")
+        generated_at = _require_utc(self.generated_at, field="generated_at")
+        if generated_at < bar_time:
+            raise ValueError("generated_at must be >= bar_time")
+        if not isinstance(self.provenance, SignalProvenance):
+            raise ValueError("provenance must be SignalProvenance")
+        if self.provenance.bar_time != bar_time:
+            raise ValueError("provenance.bar_time must match signal bar_time")
+        reference_price = None
+        if self.reference_price is not None:
+            reference_price = _to_decimal(self.reference_price, field="reference_price")
+            if reference_price <= 0:
+                raise ValueError("reference_price must be > 0")
+        confidence = None
+        if self.confidence is not None:
+            confidence = _to_decimal(self.confidence, field="confidence")
+            if confidence < 0 or confidence > 1:
+                raise ValueError("confidence must be between 0 and 1 inclusive")
+        reason = _require_non_empty_str(self.reason, field="reason")
+
+        expected_signal_id = make_signal_id(instance_id, symbol, self.action, bar_time)
+        if self.signal_id != expected_signal_id:
+            raise ValueError("signal_id does not match the signal identity fields")
+
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategy_key", strategy_key)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategy_version", strategy_version)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "instance_id", instance_id)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", bar_time)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "generated_at", generated_at)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "reference_price", reference_price)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "reason", reason)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "confidence", confidence)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def create(
+        cls,
+        *,
+        strategy_key: str,
+        strategy_version: str,
+        instance_id: str,
+        symbol: str,
+        action: SignalAction,
+        bar_time: datetime,
+        generated_at: datetime,
+        reference_price: Decimal | None,
+        reason: str,
+        provenance: SignalProvenance,
+        confidence: Decimal | None = None,
+    ) -> Signal:
+        """Construct a signal with its deterministic identifier."""
+        signal_id = make_signal_id(instance_id, symbol, action, bar_time)
+        return cls(
+            signal_id=signal_id,
+            strategy_key=strategy_key,
+            strategy_version=strategy_version,
+            instance_id=instance_id,
+            symbol=symbol,
+            action=action,
+            bar_time=bar_time,
+            generated_at=generated_at,
+            reference_price=reference_price,
+            reason=reason,
+            provenance=provenance,

+class DecisionOutcome(Enum):
+    """Routing or policy disposition of a signal."""
+
+    ACCEPT = "ACCEPT"
+    REJECT = "REJECT"
+    IGNORE = "IGNORE"
+    DEFER = "DEFER"
+
+

+class SignalDecision:
+    """A signal disposition, kept separate from all execution state."""
+
+    decision_id: str
+    signal_id: str
+    outcome: DecisionOutcome
+    decided_at: datetime
+    reason_codes: tuple[str, ...]
+    detail: str
+    defer_until: datetime | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:

+        object.__setattr__(

+        if any(not isinstance(code, str) or not code.strip() for code in self.reason_codes):

+        if self.outcome is DecisionOutcome.DEFER and self.defer_until is None:
+            raise ValueError("DEFER decisions require defer_until")

+"""Immutable strategy definitions, registrations, and evaluation results.
+
+This module uses only the Python standard library.  In particular, it does
+not import market, broker, account, order, or protection types at runtime.
+
+Design choices (2 of 3 for these strategy/signal contracts):
+1. Symbols are stripped and uppercased at the contract boundary, matching the
+   normalization used by the rest of the domain while keeping strategy keys
+   strictly lowercase snake_case.
+2. Parameter mappings are defensively shallow-copied into ``MappingProxyType``;
+   the contract makes the mapping itself read-only without prescribing or
+   transforming strategy-specific parameter values.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from enum import Enum
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from mike_trade.domain.signals import Signal
+
+__all__ = [
+    "StrategyRole",
+    "StrategyDefinition",
+    "StrategyInstance",
+    "EvaluationStatus",
+    "Evaluation",
+]
+
+_STRATEGY_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$")
+
+
+def _require_non_empty_str(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _require_strategy_key(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field)
+    if _STRATEGY_KEY_RE.fullmatch(result) is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be lowercase snake_case; got {value!r}")
+    return result
+
+
+def _require_symbol(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field).upper()
+    if any(character.isspace() for character in result):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must not contain whitespace; got {value!r}")
+    return result
+
+
+def _require_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _read_only_mapping(value: object, *, field: str) -> Mapping[str, object]:
+    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a mapping; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    copied: dict[str, object] = {}
+    for key, item in value.items():
+        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} keys must be non-empty strings")
+        copied[key] = item
+    return MappingProxyType(copied)
+
+
+def _string_tuple(value: object, *, field: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    if not isinstance(value, tuple):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a tuple")
+    if any(not isinstance(item, str) or not item.strip() for item in value):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} items must be non-empty strings")
+    return tuple(item.strip() for item in value)
+
+
+class StrategyRole(Enum):
+    """A strategy's independently registered entry or exit role."""
+
+    BUY = "BUY"
+    SELL = "SELL"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class StrategyDefinition:
+    """Static metadata and defaults published by a strategy plugin."""
+
+    strategy_key: str
+    version: str
+    role: StrategyRole
+    description: str
+    required_timeframes: tuple[str, ...]
+    warmup_bars: int
+    default_parameters: Mapping[str, object]
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "strategy_key",
+            _require_strategy_key(self.strategy_key, field="strategy_key"),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "version", _require_non_empty_str(self.version, field="version"))
+        if not isinstance(self.role, StrategyRole):
+            raise ValueError(f"role must be StrategyRole; got {type(self.role).__name__}")
+        if not isinstance(self.description, str):
+            raise ValueError("description must be str")
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "required_timeframes",
+            _string_tuple(self.required_timeframes, field="required_timeframes"),
+        )
+        if isinstance(self.warmup_bars, bool) or not isinstance(self.warmup_bars, int):
+            raise ValueError("warmup_bars must be int")
+        if self.warmup_bars < 0:
+            raise ValueError("warmup_bars must be >= 0")
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "default_parameters",
+            _read_only_mapping(self.default_parameters, field="default_parameters"),
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class StrategyInstance:
+    """One configured BUY or SELL strategy registration."""
+
+    instance_id: str
+    strategy_key: str
+    strategy_version: str
+    role: StrategyRole
+    symbol: str
+    account_scope_id: str
+    parameters: Mapping[str, object]
+    enabled: bool
+    pair_key: str | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "instance_id", _require_non_empty_str(self.instance_id, field="instance_id")
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "strategy_key",
+            _require_strategy_key(self.strategy_key, field="strategy_key"),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "strategy_version",
+            _require_non_empty_str(self.strategy_version, field="strategy_version"),
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.role, StrategyRole):
+            raise ValueError(f"role must be StrategyRole; got {type(self.role).__name__}")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol"))
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "account_scope_id",
+            _require_non_empty_str(self.account_scope_id, field="account_scope_id"),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "parameters", _read_only_mapping(self.parameters, field="parameters")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.enabled, bool):
+            raise ValueError("enabled must be bool")
+        if self.pair_key is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self, "pair_key", _require_non_empty_str(self.pair_key, field="pair_key")
+            )
+
+
+class EvaluationStatus(Enum):
+    """The complete set of outcomes from one strategy evaluation."""
+
+    NO_SIGNAL = "NO_SIGNAL"
+    SIGNAL = "SIGNAL"
+    INSUFFICIENT_DATA = "INSUFFICIENT_DATA"
+    STALE_DATA = "STALE_DATA"
+    ERROR = "ERROR"
+    NOT_DUE = "NOT_DUE"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class Evaluation:
+    """The broker-neutral result of evaluating one strategy instance."""
+
+    instance_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    evaluated_at: datetime
+    bar_time: datetime | None
+    status: EvaluationStatus
+    signal: Signal | None
+    reason: str
+    error_detail: str | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        instance_id = _require_non_empty_str(self.instance_id, field="instance_id")
+        symbol = _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "instance_id", instance_id)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "evaluated_at", _require_utc(self.evaluated_at, field="evaluated_at")
+        )
+        if self.bar_time is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time"))
+        if not isinstance(self.status, EvaluationStatus):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"status must be EvaluationStatus; got {type(self.status).__name__}"
+            )
+        if not isinstance(self.reason, str):
+            raise ValueError("reason must be str")
+        if self.error_detail is not None and not isinstance(self.error_detail, str):
+            raise ValueError("error_detail must be str or None")
+
+        if self.status is EvaluationStatus.SIGNAL:
+            if self.signal is None:
+                raise ValueError("SIGNAL evaluations require a signal")
+            if getattr(self.signal, "instance_id", None) != instance_id:
+                raise ValueError("evaluation and signal instance_id must match")
+            if getattr(self.signal, "symbol", None) != symbol:
+                raise ValueError("evaluation and signal symbol must match")
+        elif self.signal is not None:
+            raise ValueError(f"{self.status.value} evaluations must not contain a signal")
+
+        if self.status is EvaluationStatus.ERROR and not self.error_detail:
+            raise ValueError("ERROR evaluations require error_detail")

+3. Signal IDs use the full 64-character SHA-256 hex digest of a compact JSON
+   array containing trimmed instance ID, normalized symbol, action value, and
+   the bar instant normalized to a microsecond-precision UTC ``Z`` timestamp.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from enum import Enum
+from types import MappingProxyType
+
+__all__ = [
+    "SignalAction",
+    "ENABLED_SIGNAL_ACTIONS",
+    "SignalProvenance",
+    "make_signal_id",
+    "Signal",
+    "DecisionOutcome",
+    "SignalDecision",
+]
+
+_STRATEGY_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$")
+
+
+def _require_non_empty_str(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _require_strategy_key(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field)
+    if _STRATEGY_KEY_RE.fullmatch(result) is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be lowercase snake_case; got {value!r}")
+    return result
+
+
+def _require_symbol(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field).upper()
+    if any(character.isspace() for character in result):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must not contain whitespace; got {value!r}")
+    return result
+
+
+def _require_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _to_decimal(value: object, *, field: str) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        result = value
+    elif isinstance(value, int):
+        result = Decimal(value)
+    elif isinstance(value, str):
+        text = value.strip()
+        if not text:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty numeric string")
+        try:
+            result = Decimal(text)
+        except InvalidOperation:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid decimal string: {value!r}") from None
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    if not result.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite; got {result!s}")
+    return result
+
+
+class SignalAction(Enum):
+    """Signal actions; short-side members are reserved but dormant."""
+
+    ENTER_LONG = "ENTER_LONG"
+    EXIT_LONG = "EXIT_LONG"
+    ENTER_SHORT = "ENTER_SHORT"
+    COVER_SHORT = "COVER_SHORT"
+
+
+ENABLED_SIGNAL_ACTIONS = frozenset({SignalAction.ENTER_LONG, SignalAction.EXIT_LONG})
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SignalProvenance:
+    """The market-data and optional research evidence behind a signal."""
+
+    data_provider: str
+    data_feed: str
+    is_consolidated: bool
+    timeframe: str
+    bar_time: datetime
+    indicator_snapshot: Mapping[str, Decimal | None]
+    research_source: str | None = None
+    research_as_of: datetime | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "data_provider",
+            _require_non_empty_str(self.data_provider, field="data_provider"),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "data_feed", _require_non_empty_str(self.data_feed, field="data_feed")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.is_consolidated, bool):
+            raise ValueError("is_consolidated must be bool")
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "timeframe", _require_non_empty_str(self.timeframe, field="timeframe")
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time"))
+        if not isinstance(self.indicator_snapshot, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError("indicator_snapshot must be a mapping")
+        snapshot: dict[str, Decimal | None] = {}
+        for key, value in self.indicator_snapshot.items():
+            if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
+                raise ValueError("indicator_snapshot keys must be non-empty strings")
+            snapshot[key] = None if value is None else _to_decimal(value, field=f"indicator[{key}]")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "indicator_snapshot", MappingProxyType(snapshot))
+        if self.research_source is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                "research_source",
+                _require_non_empty_str(self.research_source, field="research_source"),
+            )
+        if self.research_as_of is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                "research_as_of",
+                _require_utc(self.research_as_of, field="research_as_of"),
+            )
+
+
+def make_signal_id(
+    instance_id: str,
+    symbol: str,
+    action: SignalAction,
+    bar_time: datetime,
+) -> str:
+    """Return a stable SHA-256 identifier for one instance/action/bar."""
+    normalized_instance = _require_non_empty_str(instance_id, field="instance_id")
+    normalized_symbol = _require_symbol(symbol, field="symbol")
+    if not isinstance(action, SignalAction):
+        raise ValueError(f"action must be SignalAction; got {type(action).__name__}")
+    normalized_bar_time = _require_utc(bar_time, field="bar_time")
+    timestamp = normalized_bar_time.isoformat(timespec="microseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
+    canonical = json.dumps(
+        [normalized_instance, normalized_symbol, action.value, timestamp],
+        ensure_ascii=True,
+        separators=(",", ":"),
+    )
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class Signal:
+    """A strategy's immutable long-only actionable result."""
+
+    signal_id: str
+    strategy_key: str
+    strategy_version: str
+    instance_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    action: SignalAction
+    bar_time: datetime
+    generated_at: datetime
+    reference_price: Decimal | None
+    reason: str
+    provenance: SignalProvenance
+    confidence: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        strategy_key = _require_strategy_key(self.strategy_key, field="strategy_key")
+        strategy_version = _require_non_empty_str(
+            self.strategy_version, field="strategy_version"
+        )
+        instance_id = _require_non_empty_str(self.instance_id, field="instance_id")
+        symbol = _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol")
+        if not isinstance(self.action, SignalAction):
+            raise ValueError(f"action must be SignalAction; got {type(self.action).__name__}")
+        if self.action not in ENABLED_SIGNAL_ACTIONS:
+            raise ValueError(f"signal action {self.action.value} is not enabled")
+        bar_time = _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time")
+        generated_at = _require_utc(self.generated_at, field="generated_at")
+        if generated_at < bar_time:
+            raise ValueError("generated_at must be >= bar_time")
+        if not isinstance(self.provenance, SignalProvenance):
+            raise ValueError("provenance must be SignalProvenance")
+        reference_price = None
+        if self.reference_price is not None:
+            reference_price = _to_decimal(self.reference_price, field="reference_price")
+            if reference_price <= 0:
+                raise ValueError("reference_price must be > 0")
+        confidence = None
+        if self.confidence is not None:
+            confidence = _to_decimal(self.confidence, field="confidence")
+            if confidence < 0 or confidence > 1:
+                raise ValueError("confidence must be between 0 and 1 inclusive")
+        reason = _require_non_empty_str(self.reason, field="reason")
+
+        expected_signal_id = make_signal_id(instance_id, symbol, self.action, bar_time)
+        if self.signal_id != expected_signal_id:
+            raise ValueError("signal_id does not match the signal identity fields")
+
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategy_key", strategy_key)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategy_version", strategy_version)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "instance_id", instance_id)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", bar_time)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "generated_at", generated_at)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "reference_price", reference_price)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "reason", reason)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "confidence", confidence)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def create(
+        cls,
+        *,
+        strategy_key: str,
+        strategy_version: str,
+        instance_id: str,
+        symbol: str,
+        action: SignalAction,
+        bar_time: datetime,
+        generated_at: datetime,
+        reference_price: Decimal | None,
+        reason: str,
+        provenance: SignalProvenance,
+        confidence: Decimal | None = None,
+    ) -> Signal:
+        """Construct a signal with its deterministic identifier."""
+        signal_id = make_signal_id(instance_id, symbol, action, bar_time)
+        return cls(
+            signal_id=signal_id,
+            strategy_key=strategy_key,
+            strategy_version=strategy_version,
+            instance_id=instance_id,
+            symbol=symbol,
+            action=action,
+            bar_time=bar_time,
+            generated_at=generated_at,
+            reference_price=reference_price,
+            reason=reason,
+            provenance=provenance,
+            confidence=confidence,
+        )
+
+
+class DecisionOutcome(Enum):
+    """Routing or policy disposition of a signal."""
+
+    ACCEPT = "ACCEPT"
+    REJECT = "REJECT"
+    IGNORE = "IGNORE"
+    DEFER = "DEFER"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SignalDecision:
+    """A signal disposition, kept separate from all execution state."""
+
+    decision_id: str
+    signal_id: str
+    outcome: DecisionOutcome
+    decided_at: datetime
+    reason_codes: tuple[str, ...]
+    detail: str
+    defer_until: datetime | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "decision_id", _require_non_empty_str(self.decision_id, field="decision_id")
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "signal_id", _require_non_empty_str(self.signal_id, field="signal_id")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.outcome, DecisionOutcome):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"outcome must be DecisionOutcome; got {type(self.outcome).__name__}"
+            )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "decided_at", _require_utc(self.decided_at, field="decided_at"))
+        if not isinstance(self.reason_codes, tuple):
+            raise ValueError("reason_codes must be a tuple")
+        if any(not isinstance(code, str) or not code.strip() for code in self.reason_codes):
+            raise ValueError("reason_codes items must be non-empty strings")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "reason_codes", tuple(code.strip() for code in self.reason_codes))
+        if not isinstance(self.detail, str):
+            raise ValueError("detail must be str")
+        if self.defer_until is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self, "defer_until", _require_utc(self.defer_until, field="defer_until")
+            )
+        needs_reasons = self.outcome in {DecisionOutcome.REJECT, DecisionOutcome.DEFER}
+        if needs_reasons and not self.reason_codes:
+            raise ValueError(f"{self.outcome.value} decisions require reason_codes")
+        if self.outcome is DecisionOutcome.DEFER and self.defer_until is None:
+            raise ValueError("DEFER decisions require defer_until")

+"""Immutable strategy definitions, registrations, and evaluation results.
+
+This module uses only the Python standard library.  In particular, it does
+not import market, broker, account, order, or protection types at runtime.
+
+Design choices (2 of 3 for these strategy/signal contracts):
+1. Symbols are stripped and uppercased at the contract boundary, matching the
+   normalization used by the rest of the domain while keeping strategy keys
+   strictly lowercase snake_case.
+2. Parameter mappings are defensively shallow-copied into ``MappingProxyType``;
+   the contract makes the mapping itself read-only without prescribing or
+   transforming strategy-specific parameter values.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from enum import Enum
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from mike_trade.domain.signals import Signal
+
+__all__ = [
+    "StrategyRole",
+    "StrategyDefinition",
+    "StrategyInstance",
+    "EvaluationStatus",
+    "Evaluation",
+]
+
+_STRATEGY_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$")
+
+
+def _require_non_empty_str(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _require_strategy_key(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field)
+    if _STRATEGY_KEY_RE.fullmatch(result) is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be lowercase snake_case; got {value!r}")
+    return result
+
+
+def _require_symbol(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field).upper()
+    if any(character.isspace() for character in result):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must not contain whitespace; got {value!r}")
+    return result
+
+
+def _require_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _read_only_mapping(value: object, *, field: str) -> Mapping[str, object]:
+    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a mapping; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    copied: dict[str, object] = {}
+    for key, item in value.items():
+        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} keys must be non-empty strings")
+        copied[key] = item
+    return MappingProxyType(copied)
+
+
+def _string_tuple(value: object, *, field: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    if not isinstance(value, tuple):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a tuple")
+    if any(not isinstance(item, str) or not item.strip() for item in value):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} items must be non-empty strings")
+    return tuple(item.strip() for item in value)
+
+
+class StrategyRole(Enum):
+    """A strategy's independently registered entry or exit role."""
+
+    BUY = "BUY"
+    SELL = "SELL"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class StrategyDefinition:
+    """Static metadata and defaults published by a strategy plugin."""
+
+    strategy_key: str
+    version: str
+    role: StrategyRole
+    description: str
+    required_timeframes: tuple[str, ...]
+    warmup_bars: int
+    default_parameters: Mapping[str, object]
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "strategy_key",
+            _require_strategy_key(self.strategy_key, field="strategy_key"),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "version", _require_non_empty_str(self.version, field="version"))
+        if not isinstance(self.role, StrategyRole):
+            raise ValueError(f"role must be StrategyRole; got {type(self.role).__name__}")
+        if not isinstance(self.description, str):
+            raise ValueError("description must be str")
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "required_timeframes",
+            _string_tuple(self.required_timeframes, field="required_timeframes"),
+        )
+        if isinstance(self.warmup_bars, bool) or not isinstance(self.warmup_bars, int):
+            raise ValueError("warmup_bars must be int")
+        if self.warmup_bars < 0:
+            raise ValueError("warmup_bars must be >= 0")
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "default_parameters",
+            _read_only_mapping(self.default_parameters, field="default_parameters"),
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class StrategyInstance:
+    """One configured BUY or SELL strategy registration."""
+
+    instance_id: str
+    strategy_key: str
+    strategy_version: str
+    role: StrategyRole
+    symbol: str
+    account_scope_id: str
+    parameters: Mapping[str, object]
+    enabled: bool
+    pair_key: str | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "instance_id", _require_non_empty_str(self.instance_id, field="instance_id")
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "strategy_key",
+            _require_strategy_key(self.strategy_key, field="strategy_key"),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "strategy_version",
+            _require_non_empty_str(self.strategy_version, field="strategy_version"),
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.role, StrategyRole):
+            raise ValueError(f"role must be StrategyRole; got {type(self.role).__name__}")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol"))
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "account_scope_id",
+            _require_non_empty_str(self.account_scope_id, field="account_scope_id"),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "parameters", _read_only_mapping(self.parameters, field="parameters")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.enabled, bool):
+            raise ValueError("enabled must be bool")
+        if self.pair_key is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self, "pair_key", _require_non_empty_str(self.pair_key, field="pair_key")
+            )
+
+
+class EvaluationStatus(Enum):
+    """The complete set of outcomes from one strategy evaluation."""
+
+    NO_SIGNAL = "NO_SIGNAL"
+    SIGNAL = "SIGNAL"
+    INSUFFICIENT_DATA = "INSUFFICIENT_DATA"
+    STALE_DATA = "STALE_DATA"
+    ERROR = "ERROR"
+    NOT_DUE = "NOT_DUE"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class Evaluation:
+    """The broker-neutral result of evaluating one strategy instance."""
+
+    instance_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    evaluated_at: datetime
+    bar_time: datetime | None
+    status: EvaluationStatus
+    signal: Signal | None
+    reason: str
+    error_detail: str | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        instance_id = _require_non_empty_str(self.instance_id, field="instance_id")
+        symbol = _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "instance_id", instance_id)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "evaluated_at", _require_utc(self.evaluated_at, field="evaluated_at")
+        )
+        if self.bar_time is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time"))
+        if not isinstance(self.status, EvaluationStatus):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"status must be EvaluationStatus; got {type(self.status).__name__}"
+            )
+        if not isinstance(self.reason, str):
+            raise ValueError("reason must be str")
+        if self.error_detail is not None and not isinstance(self.error_detail, str):
+            raise ValueError("error_detail must be str or None")
+
+        if self.status is EvaluationStatus.SIGNAL:
+            if self.signal is None:
+                raise ValueError("SIGNAL evaluations require a signal")
+            if getattr(self.signal, "instance_id", None) != instance_id:
+                raise ValueError("evaluation and signal instance_id must match")
+            if getattr(self.signal, "symbol", None) != symbol:
+                raise ValueError("evaluation and signal symbol must match")
+        elif self.signal is not None:
+            raise ValueError(f"{self.status.value} evaluations must not contain a signal")
+
+        if self.status is EvaluationStatus.ERROR and not self.error_detail:
+            raise ValueError("ERROR evaluations require error_detail")

+from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError, fields
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.domain.signals import (
+    ENABLED_SIGNAL_ACTIONS,
+    DecisionOutcome,
+    Signal,
+    SignalAction,
+    SignalDecision,
+    SignalProvenance,
+    make_signal_id,
+)
+from mike_trade.domain.strategy_types import (
+    Evaluation,
+    EvaluationStatus,
+    StrategyDefinition,
+    StrategyInstance,
+    StrategyRole,
+)
+
+BAR_TIME = datetime(2026, 10, 8, 14, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
+
+
+def provenance(**overrides: object) -> SignalProvenance:
+    values: dict[str, object] = {
+        "data_provider": "alpaca",
+        "data_feed": "iex",
+        "is_consolidated": False,
+        "timeframe": "1m",
+        "bar_time": BAR_TIME,
+        "indicator_snapshot": {"vwap": Decimal("101.25"), "rsi": None},
+    }
+    values.update(overrides)
+    return SignalProvenance(**values)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+
+
+def signal(**overrides: object) -> Signal:
+    values: dict[str, object] = {
+        "strategy_key": "vwap_bounce",
+        "strategy_version": "1.0",
+        "instance_id": "buy-aapl",
+        "symbol": "AAPL",
+        "action": SignalAction.ENTER_LONG,
+        "bar_time": BAR_TIME,
+        "generated_at": BAR_TIME + timedelta(seconds=1),
+        "reference_price": Decimal("101.50"),
+        "reason": "closed above VWAP",
+        "provenance": provenance(),
+    }
+    values.update(overrides)
+    return Signal.create(**values)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+
+
+def test_strategy_contracts_are_frozen_and_parameter_mappings_are_read_only() -> None:
+    defaults = {"period": 20}
+    definition = StrategyDefinition(
+        strategy_key="vwap_bounce",
+        version="1.0",
+        role=StrategyRole.BUY,
+        description="VWAP entry",
+        required_timeframes=("1m",),
+        warmup_bars=20,
+        default_parameters=defaults,
+    )
+    instance = StrategyInstance(
+        instance_id="buy-aapl",
+        strategy_key="vwap_bounce",
+        strategy_version="1.0",
+        role=StrategyRole.BUY,
+        symbol="aapl",
+        account_scope_id="paper-main",
+        parameters={"period": 20},
+        enabled=True,
+        pair_key="vwap_reference",
+    )
+
+    defaults["period"] = 30
+    assert definition.default_parameters["period"] == 20
+    assert instance.symbol == "AAPL"

+"""Immutable, broker-neutral signal, provenance, and decision contracts.
+
+Only standard-library modules are imported at runtime.  Signals deliberately
+contain no quantity, order, fill, broker, or position-cycle state.
+
+Design choice (3 of 3 for these strategy/signal contracts):
+3. Signal IDs use the full 64-character SHA-256 hex digest of a compact JSON
+   array containing trimmed instance ID, normalized symbol, action value, and
+   the bar instant normalized to a microsecond-precision UTC ``Z`` timestamp.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from enum import Enum
+from types import MappingProxyType
+
+__all__ = [
+    "SignalAction",
+    "ENABLED_SIGNAL_ACTIONS",
+    "SignalProvenance",
+    "make_signal_id",
+    "Signal",
+    "DecisionOutcome",
+    "SignalDecision",
+]
+
+_STRATEGY_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$")
+
+
+def _require_non_empty_str(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _require_strategy_key(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field)
+    if _STRATEGY_KEY_RE.fullmatch(result) is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be lowercase snake_case; got {value!r}")
+    return result
+
+
+def _require_symbol(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field).upper()
+    if any(character.isspace() for character in result):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must not contain whitespace; got {value!r}")
+    return result
+
+
+def _require_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _to_decimal(value: object, *, field: str) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        result = value
+    elif isinstance(value, int):
+        result = Decimal(value)
+    elif isinstance(value, str):
+        text = value.strip()
+        if not text:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty numeric string")
+        try:
+            result = Decimal(text)
+        except InvalidOperation:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid decimal string: {value!r}") from None
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    if not result.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite; got {result!s}")
+    return result
+
+
+class SignalAction(Enum):
+    """Signal actions; short-side members are reserved but dormant."""
+
+    ENTER_LONG = "ENTER_LONG"
+    EXIT_LONG = "EXIT_LONG"
+    ENTER_SHORT = "ENTER_SHORT"
+    COVER_SHORT = "COVER_SHORT"
+
+
+ENABLED_SIGNAL_ACTIONS = frozenset({SignalAction.ENTER_LONG, SignalAction.EXIT_LONG})
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SignalProvenance:
+    """The market-data and optional research evidence behind a signal."""
+
+    data_provider: str
+    data_feed: str
+    is_consolidated: bool
+    timeframe: str
+    bar_time: datetime
+    indicator_snapshot: Mapping[str, Decimal | None]
+    research_source: str | None = None
+    research_as_of: datetime | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "data_provider",
+            _require_non_empty_str(self.data_provider, field="data_provider"),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "data_feed", _require_non_empty_str(self.data_feed, field="data_feed")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.is_consolidated, bool):
+            raise ValueError("is_consolidated must be bool")
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "timeframe", _require_non_empty_str(self.timeframe, field="timeframe")
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time"))
+        if not isinstance(self.indicator_snapshot, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError("indicator_snapshot must be a mapping")
+        snapshot: dict[str, Decimal | None] = {}
+        for key, value in self.indicator_snapshot.items():
+            if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
+                raise ValueError("indicator_snapshot keys must be non-empty strings")
+            snapshot[key] = None if value is None else _to_decimal(value, field=f"indicator[{key}]")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "indicator_snapshot", MappingProxyType(snapshot))
+        if self.research_source is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                "research_source",
+                _require_non_empty_str(self.research_source, field="research_source"),
+            )
+        if self.research_as_of is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                "research_as_of",
+                _require_utc(self.research_as_of, field="research_as_of"),
+            )
+
+
+def make_signal_id(
+    instance_id: str,
+    symbol: str,
+    action: SignalAction,
+    bar_time: datetime,
+) -> str:
+    """Return a stable SHA-256 identifier for one instance/action/bar."""
+    normalized_instance = _require_non_empty_str(instance_id, field="instance_id")
+    normalized_symbol = _require_symbol(symbol, field="symbol")
+    if not isinstance(action, SignalAction):
+        raise ValueError(f"action must be SignalAction; got {type(action).__name__}")
+    normalized_bar_time = _require_utc(bar_time, field="bar_time")
+    timestamp = normalized_bar_time.isoformat(timespec="microseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
+    canonical = json.dumps(
+        [normalized_instance, normalized_symbol, action.value, timestamp],
+        ensure_ascii=True,
+        separators=(",", ":"),
+    )
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class Signal:
+    """A strategy's immutable long-only actionable result."""
+
+    signal_id: str
+    strategy_key: str
+    strategy_version: str
+    instance_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    action: SignalAction
+    bar_time: datetime
+    generated_at: datetime
+    reference_price: Decimal | None
+    reason: str
+    provenance: SignalProvenance
+    confidence: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        strategy_key = _require_strategy_key(self.strategy_key, field="strategy_key")
+        strategy_version = _require_non_empty_str(
+            self.strategy_version, field="strategy_version"
+        )
+        instance_id = _require_non_empty_str(self.instance_id, field="instance_id")
+        symbol = _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol")
+        if not isinstance(self.action, SignalAction):
+            raise ValueError(f"action must be SignalAction; got {type(self.action).__name__}")
+        if self.action not in ENABLED_SIGNAL_ACTIONS:
+            raise ValueError(f"signal action {self.action.value} is not enabled")
+        bar_time = _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time")
+        generated_at = _require_utc(self.generated_at, field="generated_at")
+        if generated_at < bar_time:
+            raise ValueError("generated_at must be >= bar_time")
+        if not isinstance(self.provenance, SignalProvenance):
+            raise ValueError("provenance must be SignalProvenance")
+        reference_price = None
+        if self.reference_price is not None:
+            reference_price = _to_decimal(self.reference_price, field="reference_price")
+            if reference_price <= 0:
+                raise ValueError("reference_price must be > 0")
+        confidence = None
+        if self.confidence is not None:
+            confidence = _to_decimal(self.confidence, field="confidence")
+            if confidence < 0 or confidence > 1:
+                raise ValueError("confidence must be between 0 and 1 inclusive")
+        reason = _require_non_empty_str(self.reason, field="reason")
+
+        expected_signal_id = make_signal_id(instance_id, symbol, self.action, bar_time)
+        if self.signal_id != expected_signal_id:
+            raise ValueError("signal_id does not match the signal identity fields")
+
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategy_key", strategy_key)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategy_version", strategy_version)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "instance_id", instance_id)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", bar_time)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "generated_at", generated_at)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "reference_price", reference_price)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "reason", reason)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "confidence", confidence)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def create(
+        cls,
+        *,
+        strategy_key: str,
+        strategy_version: str,
+        instance_id: str,
+        symbol: str,
+        action: SignalAction,
+        bar_time: datetime,
+        generated_at: datetime,
+        reference_price: Decimal | None,
+        reason: str,
+        provenance: SignalProvenance,
+        confidence: Decimal | None = None,
+    ) -> Signal:
+        """Construct a signal with its deterministic identifier."""
+        signal_id = make_signal_id(instance_id, symbol, action, bar_time)
+        return cls(
+            signal_id=signal_id,
+            strategy_key=strategy_key,
+            strategy_version=strategy_version,
+            instance_id=instance_id,
+            symbol=symbol,
+            action=action,
+            bar_time=bar_time,
+            generated_at=generated_at,
+            reference_price=reference_price,
+            reason=reason,
+            provenance=provenance,
+            confidence=confidence,
+        )
+
+
+class DecisionOutcome(Enum):
+    """Routing or policy disposition of a signal."""
+
+    ACCEPT = "ACCEPT"
+    REJECT = "REJECT"
+    IGNORE = "IGNORE"
+    DEFER = "DEFER"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SignalDecision:
+    """A signal disposition, kept separate from all execution state."""
+
+    decision_id: str
+    signal_id: str
+    outcome: DecisionOutcome
+    decided_at: datetime
+    reason_codes: tuple[str, ...]
+    detail: str
+    defer_until: datetime | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "decision_id", _require_non_empty_str(self.decision_id, field="decision_id")
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "signal_id", _require_non_empty_str(self.signal_id, field="signal_id")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.outcome, DecisionOutcome):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"outcome must be DecisionOutcome; got {type(self.outcome).__name__}"
+            )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "decided_at", _require_utc(self.decided_at, field="decided_at"))
+        if not isinstance(self.reason_codes, tuple):
+            raise ValueError("reason_codes must be a tuple")
+        if any(not isinstance(code, str) or not code.strip() for code in self.reason_codes):
+            raise ValueError("reason_codes items must be non-empty strings")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "reason_codes", tuple(code.strip() for code in self.reason_codes))
+        if not isinstance(self.detail, str):
+            raise ValueError("detail must be str")
+        if self.defer_until is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self, "defer_until", _require_utc(self.defer_until, field="defer_until")
+            )
+        needs_reasons = self.outcome in {DecisionOutcome.REJECT, DecisionOutcome.DEFER}
+        if needs_reasons and not self.reason_codes:
+            raise ValueError(f"{self.outcome.value} decisions require reason_codes")
+        if self.outcome is DecisionOutcome.DEFER and self.defer_until is None:
+            raise ValueError("DEFER decisions require defer_until")

+"""Immutable strategy definitions, registrations, and evaluation results.
+
+This module uses only the Python standard library.  In particular, it does
+not import market, broker, account, order, or protection types at runtime.
+
+Design choices (2 of 3 for these strategy/signal contracts):
+1. Symbols are stripped and uppercased at the contract boundary, matching the
+   normalization used by the rest of the domain while keeping strategy keys
+   strictly lowercase snake_case.
+2. Parameter mappings are defensively shallow-copied into ``MappingProxyType``;
+   the contract makes the mapping itself read-only without prescribing or
+   transforming strategy-specific parameter values.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from enum import Enum
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from mike_trade.domain.signals import Signal
+
+__all__ = [
+    "StrategyRole",
+    "StrategyDefinition",
+    "StrategyInstance",
+    "EvaluationStatus",
+    "Evaluation",
+]
+
+_STRATEGY_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$")
+
+
+def _require_non_empty_str(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _require_strategy_key(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field)
+    if _STRATEGY_KEY_RE.fullmatch(result) is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be lowercase snake_case; got {value!r}")
+    return result
+
+
+def _require_symbol(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field).upper()
+    if any(character.isspace() for character in result):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must not contain whitespace; got {value!r}")
+    return result

+3. Signal IDs use the full 64-character SHA-256 hex digest of a compact JSON

+    timeframe: str
+    bar_time: datetime
+    indicator_snapshot: Mapping[str, Decimal | None]
+    research_source: str | None = None
+    research_as_of: datetime | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "data_provider",
+            _require_non_empty_str(self.data_provider, field="data_provider"),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "data_feed", _require_non_empty_str(self.data_feed, field="data_feed")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.is_consolidated, bool):
+            raise ValueError("is_consolidated must be bool")
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "timeframe", _require_non_empty_str(self.timeframe, field="timeframe")
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time"))
+        if not isinstance(self.indicator_snapshot, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError("indicator_snapshot must be a mapping")
+        snapshot: dict[str, Decimal | None] = {}
+        for key, value in self.indicator_snapshot.items():
+            if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
+                raise ValueError("indicator_snapshot keys must be non-empty strings")
+            snapshot[key] = None if value is None else _to_decimal(value, field=f"indicator[{key}]")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "indicator_snapshot", MappingProxyType(snapshot))
+        if self.research_source is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                "research_source",
+                _require_non_empty_str(self.research_source, field="research_source"),
+            )
+        if self.research_as_of is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                "research_as_of",
+                _require_utc(self.research_as_of, field="research_as_of"),
+            )
+
+
+def make_signal_id(
+    instance_id: str,
+    symbol: str,
+    action: SignalAction,
+    bar_time: datetime,
+) -> str:
+    """Return a stable SHA-256 identifier for one instance/action/bar."""
+    normalized_instance = _require_non_empty_str(instance_id, field="instance_id")
+    normalized_symbol = _require_symbol(symbol, field="symbol")
+    if not isinstance(action, SignalAction):
+        raise ValueError(f"action must be SignalAction; got {type(action).__name__}")
+    normalized_bar_time = _require_utc(bar_time, field="bar_time")
+    timestamp = normalized_bar_time.isoformat(timespec="microseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
+    canonical = json.dumps(
+        [normalized_instance, normalized_symbol, action.value, timestamp],
+        ensure_ascii=True,
+        separators=(",", ":"),
+    )
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class Signal:
+    """A strategy's immutable long-only actionable result."""
+
+    signal_id: str
+    strategy_key: str
+    strategy_version: str
+    instance_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    action: SignalAction
+    bar_time: datetime
+    generated_at: datetime
+    reference_price: Decimal | None
+    reason: str
+    provenance: SignalProvenance
+    confidence: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        strategy_key = _require_strategy_key(self.strategy_key, field="strategy_key")
+        strategy_version = _require_non_empty_str(
+            self.strategy_version, field="strategy_version"
+        )
+        instance_id = _require_non_empty_str(self.instance_id, field="instance_id")
+        symbol = _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol")
+        if not isinstance(self.action, SignalAction):
+            raise ValueError(f"action must be SignalAction; got {type(self.action).__name__}")
+        if self.action not in ENABLED_SIGNAL_ACTIONS:
+            raise ValueError(f"signal action {self.action.value} is not enabled")
+        bar_time = _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time")
+        generated_at = _require_utc(self.generated_at, field="generated_at")
+        if generated_at < bar_time:
+            raise ValueError("generated_at must be >= bar_time")
+        if not isinstance(self.provenance, SignalProvenance):
+            raise ValueError("provenance must be SignalProvenance")
+        reference_price = None
+        if self.reference_price is not None:
+            reference_price = _to_decimal(self.reference_price, field="reference_price")
+            if reference_price <= 0:
+                raise ValueError("reference_price must be > 0")
+        confidence = None
+        if self.confidence is not None:
+            confidence = _to_decimal(self.confidence, field="confidence")
+            if confidence < 0 or confidence > 1:
+                raise ValueError("confidence must be between 0 and 1 inclusive")
+        reason = _require_non_empty_str(self.reason, field="reason")
+
+        expected_signal_id = make_signal_id(instance_id, symbol, self.action, bar_time)
+        if self.signal_id != expected_signal_id:
+            raise ValueError("signal_id does not match the signal identity fields")
+
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategy_key", strategy_key)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategy_version", strategy_version)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "instance_id", instance_id)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", bar_time)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "generated_at", generated_at)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "reference_price", reference_price)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "reason", reason)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "confidence", confidence)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def create(
+        cls,
+        *,
+        strategy_key: str,
+        strategy_version: str,
+        instance_id: str,
+        symbol: str,
+        action: SignalAction,
+        bar_time: datetime,
+        generated_at: datetime,
+        reference_price: Decimal | None,
+        reason: str,
+        provenance: SignalProvenance,
+        confidence: Decimal | None = None,
+    ) -> Signal:
+        """Construct a signal with its deterministic identifier."""
+        signal_id = make_signal_id(instance_id, symbol, action, bar_time)
+        return cls(
+            signal_id=signal_id,
+            strategy_key=strategy_key,
+            strategy_version=strategy_version,
+            instance_id=instance_id,
+            symbol=symbol,
+            action=action,
+            bar_time=bar_time,
+            generated_at=generated_at,
+            reference_price=reference_price,
+            reason=reason,
+            provenance=provenance,
+            confidence=confidence,
+        )
+
+
+class DecisionOutcome(Enum):
+    """Routing or policy disposition of a signal."""
+
+    ACCEPT = "ACCEPT"
+    REJECT = "REJECT"
+    IGNORE = "IGNORE"
+    DEFER = "DEFER"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SignalDecision:
+    """A signal disposition, kept separate from all execution state."""
+
+    decision_id: str
+    signal_id: str
+    outcome: DecisionOutcome
+    decided_at: datetime
+    reason_codes: tuple[str, ...]
+    detail: str
+    defer_until: datetime | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "decision_id", _require_non_empty_str(self.decision_id, field="decision_id")
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "signal_id", _require_non_empty_str(self.signal_id, field="signal_id")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.outcome, DecisionOutcome):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"outcome must be DecisionOutcome; got {type(self.outcome).__name__}"
+            )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "decided_at", _require_utc(self.decided_at, field="decided_at"))
+        if not isinstance(self.reason_codes, tuple):
+            raise ValueError("reason_codes must be a tuple")
+        if any(not isinstance(code, str) or not code.strip() for code in self.reason_codes):
+            raise ValueError("reason_codes items must be non-empty strings")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "reason_codes", tuple(code.strip() for code in self.reason_codes))
+        if not isinstance(self.detail, str):
+            raise ValueError("detail must be str")
+        if self.defer_until is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self, "defer_until", _require_utc(self.defer_until, field="defer_until")
+            )
+        needs_reasons = self.outcome in {DecisionOutcome.REJECT, DecisionOutcome.DEFER}
+        if needs_reasons and not self.reason_codes:
+            raise ValueError(f"{self.outcome.value} decisions require reason_codes")
+        if self.outcome is DecisionOutcome.DEFER and self.defer_until is None:
+            raise ValueError("DEFER decisions require defer_until")

+"""Immutable strategy definitions, registrations, and evaluation results.
+
+This module uses only the Python standard library.  In particular, it does
+not import market, broker, account, order, or protection types at runtime.
+
+Design choices (2 of 3 for these strategy/signal contracts):
+1. Symbols are stripped and uppercased at the contract boundary, matching the
+   normalization used by the rest of the domain while keeping strategy keys
+   strictly lowercase snake_case.
+2. Parameter mappings are defensively shallow-copied into ``MappingProxyType``;
+   the contract makes the mapping itself read-only without prescribing or
+   transforming strategy-specific parameter values.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from enum import Enum
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from mike_trade.domain.signals import Signal
+
+__all__ = [
+    "StrategyRole",
+    "StrategyDefinition",
+    "StrategyInstance",
+    "EvaluationStatus",
+    "Evaluation",
+]
+
+_STRATEGY_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$")
+
+
+def _require_non_empty_str(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _require_strategy_key(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field)
+    if _STRATEGY_KEY_RE.fullmatch(result) is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be lowercase snake_case; got {value!r}")
+    return result
+
+
+def _require_symbol(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field).upper()
+    if any(character.isspace() for character in result):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must not contain whitespace; got {value!r}")
+    return result
+
+
+def _require_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _read_only_mapping(value: object, *, field: str) -> Mapping[str, object]:
+    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a mapping; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    copied: dict[str, object] = {}
+    for key, item in value.items():
+        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} keys must be non-empty strings")
+        copied[key] = item
+    return MappingProxyType(copied)
+
+
+def _string_tuple(value: object, *, field: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    if not isinstance(value, tuple):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a tuple")
+    if any(not isinstance(item, str) or not item.strip() for item in value):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} items must be non-empty strings")
+    return tuple(item.strip() for item in value)
+
+
+class StrategyRole(Enum):
+    """A strategy's independently registered entry or exit role."""
+
+    BUY = "BUY"
+    SELL = "SELL"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class StrategyDefinition:
+    """Static metadata and defaults published by a strategy plugin."""
+
+    strategy_key: str
+    version: str
+    role: StrategyRole
+    description: str
+    required_timeframes: tuple[str, ...]
+    warmup_bars: int
+    default_parameters: Mapping[str, object]
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "strategy_key",
+            _require_strategy_key(self.strategy_key, field="strategy_key"),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "version", _require_non_empty_str(self.version, field="version"))
+        if not isinstance(self.role, StrategyRole):
+            raise ValueError(f"role must be StrategyRole; got {type(self.role).__name__}")
+        if not isinstance(self.description, str):
+            raise ValueError("description must be str")
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "required_timeframes",
+            _string_tuple(self.required_timeframes, field="required_timeframes"),
+        )
+        if isinstance(self.warmup_bars, bool) or not isinstance(self.warmup_bars, int):
+            raise ValueError("warmup_bars must be int")
+        if self.warmup_bars < 0:
+            raise ValueError("warmup_bars must be >= 0")
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "default_parameters",
+            _read_only_mapping(self.default_parameters, field="default_parameters"),
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class StrategyInstance:
+    """One configured BUY or SELL strategy registration."""
+
+    instance_id: str
+    strategy_key: str
+    strategy_version: str
+    role: StrategyRole
+    symbol: str
+    account_scope_id: str
+    parameters: Mapping[str, object]
+    enabled: bool
+    pair_key: str | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "instance_id", _require_non_empty_str(self.instance_id, field="instance_id")
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "strategy_key",
+            _require_strategy_key(self.strategy_key, field="strategy_key"),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "strategy_version",
+            _require_non_empty_str(self.strategy_version, field="strategy_version"),
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.role, StrategyRole):
+            raise ValueError(f"role must be StrategyRole; got {type(self.role).__name__}")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol"))
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "account_scope_id",
+            _require_non_empty_str(self.account_scope_id, field="account_scope_id"),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "parameters", _read_only_mapping(self.parameters, field="parameters")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.enabled, bool):
+            raise ValueError("enabled must be bool")
+        if self.pair_key is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self, "pair_key", _require_non_empty_str(self.pair_key, field="pair_key")
+            )
+
+
+class EvaluationStatus(Enum):
+    """The complete set of outcomes from one strategy evaluation."""
+
+    NO_SIGNAL = "NO_SIGNAL"
+    SIGNAL = "SIGNAL"
+    INSUFFICIENT_DATA = "INSUFFICIENT_DATA"
+    STALE_DATA = "STALE_DATA"
+    ERROR = "ERROR"
+    NOT_DUE = "NOT_DUE"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class Evaluation:
+    """The broker-neutral result of evaluating one strategy instance."""
+
+    instance_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    evaluated_at: datetime
+    bar_time: datetime | None
+    status: EvaluationStatus
+    signal: Signal | None
+    reason: str
+    error_detail: str | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        instance_id = _require_non_empty_str(self.instance_id, field="instance_id")
+        symbol = _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "instance_id", instance_id)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "evaluated_at", _require_utc(self.evaluated_at, field="evaluated_at")
+        )
+        if self.bar_time is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time"))
+        if not isinstance(self.status, EvaluationStatus):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"status must be EvaluationStatus; got {type(self.status).__name__}"
+            )
+        if not isinstance(self.reason, str):
+            raise ValueError("reason must be str")
+        if self.error_detail is not None and not isinstance(self.error_detail, str):
+            raise ValueError("error_detail must be str or None")
+
+        if self.status is EvaluationStatus.SIGNAL:
+            if self.signal is None:
+                raise ValueError("SIGNAL evaluations require a signal")
+            if getattr(self.signal, "instance_id", None) != instance_id:
+                raise ValueError("evaluation and signal instance_id must match")
+            if getattr(self.signal, "symbol", None) != symbol:
+                raise ValueError("evaluation and signal symbol must match")
+        elif self.signal is not None:
+            raise ValueError(f"{self.status.value} evaluations must not contain a signal")
+
+        if self.status is EvaluationStatus.ERROR and not self.error_detail:
+            raise ValueError("ERROR evaluations require error_detail")
